mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trophy ( member_id, trophy_type, acquired_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{trophyType}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT t.trophy_id AS trophyId, t.member_id AS memberId, t.trophy_type AS trophyType, t.acquired_at AS acquiredAt FROM trophy t WHERE t.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY t.acquired_at DESC, t.trophy_id DESC
